 Japan earthquake: 6.0 magnitude tremors strikes Shima region
 SECTIONS Japan earthquake: 6.0 magnitude tremors strikes Shima region ET Online Last Updated: Nov 01, 2026, 08:35:00 AM IST Rate Story Follow us Share Font Size Abc Small Abc Medium Abc Large Save Print Comment Synopsis A magnitude 6.0 earthquake occurred near Shima, Japan, on Sunday at around 3:45 AM local time. The earthquake's tremors were felt in parts of Fukushima Prefecture, reaching a level of 3 on the seismic-intensity scale. Meanwhile, the Japan Meteorological Agency confirmed the tremors but did not issue a tsunami warning. Authorities are currently assessing the situation for any potential damage or casualties.
 Agencies Japan earthquake A magnitude 6.0 earthquake struck 58 km SSE of Shima, Japan on Sunday at around 3:45 AM, PTI reported citing US Geological Survey.
 The tremors occurred at a depth of 352 km and were recorded at 22:15 UTC on Saturday, October 31.
According to a Times of India report, the Japan Meteorological Agency reported tremors measuring 3 on its seven-point seismic-intensity scale in parts of Fukushima Prefecture. 
The authorities did not issue any tsunami warning, and no immediate reports of damage or casualties were available.
